project_type: React 19 + React Router 7 + Tailwind CSS 4 + shadcn/ui forum application
test_framework: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck (no unit test runner)
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm typecheck in web/ to verify TypeScript compiles. 2. Run pnpm lint in web/ to verify no lint errors. 3. Run pnpm build in web/ to verify production build succeeds.
environment_constraints: Tailwind CSS 4 uses @theme inline directive in globals.css instead of tailwind.config.js. shadcn/ui components reference CSS variables like --primary, --background, --foreground, etc. Theme switching uses .dark class on <html> element. No tailwind.config.ts exists - all config is in CSS.
contribution_requirements: Keep UI changes backward-compatible with existing shadcn/ui components. Support en-US and zh-CN. Include screenshots for UI changes when possible.
key_patterns: CSS variables defined in :root and .dark selectors in globals.css. @theme inline block maps CSS vars to Tailwind utilities. @layer base for resets, @layer components for component styles. Separate CSS files imported into globals.css for each domain (topic, editor, user, auth, content, pages). shadcn/ui expects oklch color variables for --primary, --background, --foreground, --card, --border, --muted, --accent, --destructive, --secondary, --popover, --ring, --input, --chart-1 through chart-5, --sidebar-* vars. The @custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *)) directive is used for dark mode variant.
directory_structure: web/styles/ - All CSS files. web/components/ - React components including layout/, ui/ (shadcn), common/. web/app/ - React Router routes and root. web/lib/ - Utilities and API client.
